name: Alt Text Assistant
author: alttextassistant

sections.description:
Alt Text Assistant automatically generates descriptive alt text for your images using AI technology. Perfect for improving website accessibility, SEO, and user experience.

Features

  • AI-powered alt text generation
  • Credit-based system for usage tracking
  • Bulk image processing
  • Multiple language support
  • Customizable alt text styles
  • Media library integration
  • Easy API configuration

How it works

  1. Configure your API endpoint and key
  2. Select images from your media library
  3. Generate alt text with one click
  4. Automatically save to image metadata

External services

This plugin connects to the AltTextGenie.com API to generate alt text for images using artificial intelligence. This service is required for the core functionality of generating alt text.

What data is sent and when:
– Image files are sent to the API when you manually request alt text generation or when auto-generation is enabled
– Only image data (no personal user information) is transmitted
– The API processes the images to analyze their content and generate descriptive alt text

Service provider information:
– Service: AltTextGenie AI Alt Text Generation API
– What it does: Analyzes images and generates descriptive alt text using AI
– Terms & Privacy Policy: https://alttextgenie.com/terms-privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Alt Text Assistant folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure your API settings under ‘Alt Text Assistant’ → ‘API Settings’
  4. Start generating alt text for your images
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, you need an API key from alttextgenie.com to use this plugin.

How many credits do I get?

Credits are provided based on your subscription plan at alttextgenie.com.

What languages are supported?

Over 130+ language
